description: Na₆Ca₄Ta₂Si₃(SO₆)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.56 Å) and three longer (2.75 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.50 Å) and three longer (2.87 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.59 Å) and three longer (2.77 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and three longer (2.31 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.43 Å) and three longer (2.44 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.33 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.20 Å) and three longer (2.39 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.15 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.72 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TaO₆ octahedra and corners with three CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-44°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.52 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TaO₆ octahedra and corners with three CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-49°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one S atom.
